lab.title: Labs
lab.intro: Hands-on apps that really work: watch a neuron learn, train a network, build a tiny language model, wire a smart classroom and crack a secret code. Everything runs on your phone, offline.
labs.ladderBody: Climb from a single neuron to whole networks, language models and machines that make decisions. Each step builds on the one before.
labs.saveAllMb: Save all labs for offline ({mb} MB)
labs.saved: All labs are saved on this phone and work offline.
labs.saveFailed: Saving stopped. Check your connection and try again.
labs.notSaved: This lab isn’t on your phone yet. Connect once, or save all labs for offline.
labs.unknown: This lab isn’t available in this version of Darsi.

pwa.offline: You’re offline — downloaded lessons still work
pwa.update: A new version of Darsi is ready
pwa.installTitle: Add Darsi to your home screen
pwa.installBody: Opens like an app, works offline, uses under 2 MB.
pwa.iosInstall: On iPhone: tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.

project.guest: To send your work to a teacher for review, sign in or create an account (it’s free). You can still do the task in class.
auth.signInSub: Sign in with your email or the username your school gave you.
auth.signUpSub: Free for individual teachers and learners.

auth.name: Full name

auth.forgotUsername: Signed in with a username? Ask your organization admin to reset your password.
auth.setPwSub: Your account was created by your organization. Pick a password only you know.
auth.errExists: An account with this email already exists.
auth.errNetwork: No connection. Try again when you are online.
auth.errTooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
auth.errGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.notConfigured: Accounts are not connected yet: add your Firebase settings to apps/web/.env.local.

ntf.title: Notifications
ntf.masterD: At most one reminder a day, at the time you choose
ntf.remindersD: A friendly daily nudge for a 5-minute lesson
ntf.reviewsD: When your project has been reviewed
ntf.staffD: New projects to review and new organization requests
ntf.guest: Create an account or sign in to get friendly reminders and project feedback on this phone.
ntf.unconfigured: Notifications aren’t set up for Darsi yet. You’ll be able to turn them on here once they are.
ntf.unsupported: This browser can’t show notifications. On Android, open Darsi in Chrome to turn them on.
ntf.iosInstall: On iPhone, add Darsi to your Home Screen first: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Open Darsi from there to turn on notifications (iOS 16.4 or later).
ntf.denied: Notifications are blocked for Darsi in this browser. To allow them, tap the icon next to the web address, open Site settings (or Permissions) and set Notifications to Allow. Then come back here.
ntf.dismissed: Notifications are still off. Tap the switch again and choose Allow when your browser asks.
ntf.onMsg: Notifications are on. You’ll get at most one reminder a day.
ntf.err: Couldn’t update notifications. Check your connection and try again.
bc.title: Send an announcement
bc.intro: Each phone gets the language its owner uses. Only people who turned on Announcements receive it.
bc.confirm: Send this announcement now? Audience: {audience}. A sent announcement can’t be taken back.
bc.sentPartial: Announcement sent, but the {lang} version failed. Sending again would repeat it in the other language, so check Recent announcements first.
bc.failed: The announcement wasn’t sent. Try again.
